title: Box-furnace fork extraction versus bogie loading: comparing the handling arrangements
summary: When comparing high-temperature furnaces, first establish whether workpieces must enter water quickly after discharge and which mechanism will transfer them. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s documents dated 12 February 2023 contain a box furnace with fork extraction and a bogie-hearth furnace for the same project. The former proposes fork extraction followed by lowering into water; the latter carries workpieces into and out of the furnace on a bogie. The available records do not establish whether these were alternatives or parallel installations. This article compares handling routes and supply boundaries, without claiming interchangeability or suitability for the same process.
